beats.narration_text: Hi — I'm Sudhanva, with week three of the RL Environments project update. Last week a scripted cue did the cooperating. This week it's gone, and the ants learn to carry anyway.

props.segment: Week 3: Did They Learn It This Time?
props.command: Take the cue out, drop every hand-coded aid, and tell me honestly how much of the teamwork the ants learn.
output: cue removed: 8/12 — but hand-coded syncing did most of the pairing
a PPO timeout bug slowed learning · fixed

beats.narration_text: Without the cue, the ants can still learn to carry food together. It looked like they needed hand-coded help. What helped was a bug fix and more training.

props.text:
Without the cue the ants
need hand-coded help
to carry food together

shot.visual_intent: Writer types the arriving framing ('need hand-coded help'), strikes it, corrects to 'can still learn'. Final text = the film's claim (12 words, fits 9:16).

beats.speed_reason: audio window >= 9 s (EXECUTIVE-SUMMARY LAW TIMING); 1.0 gave 8.30 s, 0.9 gave 8.98 s

qc.sparse_reason: Hesitant-writer bookend: the overview is typed line by line, so mid-beat frames are mostly page by design.

beats.narration_text: Step one: the cue came out; those slots now point home. IPPO still scored eight of twelve — because two hand-coded aids made ants on one piece act alike. They never once disagreed. Switch both off: about four.

shot.new_visual_element: Own-feature strip: slots 3–4 'step to target' struck, now 'home_x, home_y' (real values); e7cfa42 bar 8.00 → aids-off bar 4.33; '0 of 988' chip
shot.visual_intent: SHOW: evidence/e7_results.json (8.00 reproduced, 0/988 pair disagreements) + head_results.json slots + ab bug-ippo (4.33)

show.event: six-slot own-feature strip; slots 3–4 read 'step to target' (1166e33), struck through
slots 3–4 retype as home_x 0.3, home_y 0.2 (a real state); small arrow to the nest
bar grows to 8.00 — 'e7cfa42 · IPPO · 150k steps · 3 seeds'
two tags on the bar: 'inputs rewritten to match' · 'shared random draws in training'
chip: pairs disagreed 0 of 988 steps (terracotta ring)
second bar grows to 4.33 — 'both aids off'

beats.narration_text: Step two: a bug. The loop didn't count a time limit as an ending, so the last step borrowed the value of the next episode's fresh start — running out of time never looked costly. Fixing it raises the score at both budgets we tried.

shot.new_visual_element: TD error with the (1 − d_t) term boxed; the critic's value over one real episode, bug vs fix; then IPPO bars at equal budgets, bug vs fix, 150k and 1M
shot.visual_intent: SHOW: e478b7b train.py diff as the equation; evidence/bug_bootstrap.json v_over_time; head_results.json ab (150k, my runs) and bug1m vs curves (1M, my runs vs saved runs); 3 seeds each

show.event: MathTex: δ_t = r_t + γ(1 − d_t)V(s_{t+1}) − V(s_t); (1 − d_t) boxed in terracotta; caption 'at a timeout, d_t = 0'
episode strip '… t = 99 | reset | t = 0 …'; the s_{t+1} arrow crosses the reset
chart, one real episode: the bug-trained critic's value ends at 1.94; the fixed critic's falls to 0.10
chart gives way to IPPO bars, 3 seeds: 150k 4.33 → 6.20 · 1M 8.64 → 11.77; caption MAPPO 3.97 → 5.83 · 10.27 → 11.48
the with-bug 1M bar stays visible at 8.64: the bug slowed learning, it did not stop it

beats.narration_text: Train longer. The old runs stopped at a hundred fifty thousand steps, just as transport was taking off. At a million: IPPO eleven point eight of twelve, MAPPO eleven point five. Open space: about eight, not converged.

shot.new_visual_element: Learning curves (team food, mean of 3 seeds) for grid IPPO/MAPPO and free IPPO/MAPPO to 1M; terracotta marker at 150k
shot.visual_intent: SHOW: evidence/head_results.json curves (from each run's metrics.csv, runs/fix-compare/honest)

show.event: axes 0–1M steps × 0–12 food; grid IPPO and MAPPO curves draw left to right
terracotta vertical marker at 150k: 'old runs stopped here'
end labels land: IPPO 11.77, MAPPO 11.48
free-world curves draw (lighter): IPPO 8.55, MAPPO 7.85; tag 'not converged' (MAPPO dipped at its last evaluation)

beats.act: the check: is the pairing learned?
beats.narration_text: Is the pairing learned now? Here a partner joins, and they pull together, five cells home. Untrained, two holders match moves about one time in ten; trained, about nine in ten, nearly always homeward. A shared view helps. Measured this week: in open space, most pieces moved mostly in pairs.

shot.new_visual_element: A real greedy carry (IPPO s0, 1M, seed 10008, t 33–41); trained-vs-untrained counters on the same two-holder states (sampled same move; matched pulls heading home); free-world pair/solo bars
shot.visual_intent: SHOW: head_results.json trajectory; pairing_same_view.json (from the IPPO reel's ippo_evidence.py, same states, trained vs untrained); week3_v2_results.json free-world delivered_mostly_by_pairs

show.event: the real episode at t = 33: one ant grabs a piece and holds alone (t = 34–35); a second ant arrives (t = 36), both ringed
piece moves north, east, north, east, east into the nest (t = 36–41); trail drawn
per-seed pair: untrained 11.9% · 12.2% · 10.0% same move (sampled as in training)
trained bars beside them: 96.7% · 87.9% · 90.4%
matched pulls heading home: trained 99.1% · 99.1% · 98.6% vs untrained 40.3% · 37.5% · 39.8%
small note: two holders share a cell, so their views are identical; greedy agreement trained 99.1/89.3/90.4% vs untrained 62.8/85.3/30.8%
free-world bars: IPPO 271 of 411 pieces mostly in pairs (11 dragged solo); MAPPO 214 of 363 (42 solo)

beats.narration_text: Verdict: on the grid, they learn to carry together, imperfectly. Next week: hide one holder's home vector, and see whether the pair still agrees.

props.artifactTitle: Did They Learn It This Time?
artifactLines: Cue and hand-coded pairing aids removed; their results withdrawn.
Timeout fix, same budget (IPPO): 4.33 → 6.20 at 150k, 8.64 → 11.77 at 1M.
1M, grid: IPPO 11.77 / 12, MAPPO 11.48 / 12. Holders match ~9 in 10 (untrained ~1 in 10).
Not shown yet: how pairs agree · open space at convergence · IQL, VDN, QMIX.
